N-R-rauch.objects: Normal Jacobi field J along a specified unit-speed geodesic in a smooth n-manifold.
N-R-rauch.domain: 0<t<min(T,D_k); the lower-sectional branch additionally excludes actual conjugate points through T.
N-R-rauch.fixed_and_variable: Fix the metric, geodesic, n, k and positive initial-derivative norm a; the time and field obey those data.
N-R-rauch.hypotheses: Every radial two-plane has the stated sectional bound; no global completeness is needed for this fixed-geodesic statement.
N-R-rauch.equations: J(0)=0 and |J'(0)|=a>0; the unit-normalized s solves s''+ks=0.
N-R-rauch.quantifiers: The radial curvature bound covers the whole segment and the conclusion every indicated time, separately in its two cases.
N-R-rauch.conclusion: Upper sectional curvature gives |J|>=a s; lower gives |J|<=a s on the actual-conjugate-restricted interval.
N-R-rauch.status: Known constant-model specialization; the new text derives its operational use, not an original theorem.
N-R-rauch.local_definitions: Normal Jacobi field is defined locally in N-D-jacobi; s and D_k are defined in this statement.

N-R-hessian.objects: The Hessian of r=d(p,.) on a connected complete smooth n-manifold.
N-R-hessian.domain: x is neither p nor a cut point, and 0<r(x)<D_k.
N-R-hessian.fixed_and_variable: Fix metric, p, k and x; quantify every tangent X at x.
N-R-hessian.hypotheses: Only planes containing the tangent to the unique minimizing segment need the sectional bound; completeness and regularity are explicit.
N-R-hessian.equations: Quadratic-form bound uses c_k(r)(|X|^2-dr(X)^2), retaining the zero radial component.
N-R-hessian.quantifiers: All tangent vectors are covered and the sectional upper/lower cases are stated separately.
N-R-hessian.conclusion: Lower sectional gives the upper Hessian form; upper sectional reverses it.
N-R-hessian.status: Classical smooth-domain comparison; no extension through the cut locus is asserted.
N-R-hessian.local_definitions: r, s and D_k are specified within the block; the Hessian operation is supplied by the preceding entry.

N-R-laplacian.objects: Scalar Laplacian of distance on a connected complete smooth n-manifold.
N-R-laplacian.domain: Every x outside p and Cut(p), with 0<r(x)<D_k.
N-R-laplacian.fixed_and_variable: Fix the metric and k; p and each regular x are arbitrary.
N-R-laplacian.hypotheses: Ric >= (n-1)k g globally; the claim does not require sectional lower curvature.
N-R-laplacian.equations: Delta=div grad and the bound is (n-1)s'/s with unnormalized Ricci.
N-R-laplacian.quantifiers: For every base point and every regular point in the displayed range.
N-R-laplacian.conclusion: A scalar upper bound; no full directional Hessian or Ricci-upper reversal follows.
N-R-laplacian.status: Known comparison; the singular scalar boundary argument is explicitly supplied.
N-R-laplacian.local_definitions: r, s, D_k and Laplacian sign are fixed in the block.

N-R-bishop-gromov.objects: Volumes of concentric open metric balls and balls in the complete simply connected n-dimensional space form.
N-R-bishop-gromov.domain: All finite radii 0<r<R; positive-curvature model volume is constant at and beyond D_k.
N-R-bishop-gromov.fixed_and_variable: Fix the metric, n and k; choose any center p and then any ordered pair of radii.
N-R-bishop-gromov.hypotheses: Connected complete smooth manifold and Ric >= (n-1)k g.
N-R-bishop-gromov.equations: The ratio is nonincreasing, bounded above by 1 and tends to 1 at zero; the equivalent growth ratio is stated.
N-R-bishop-gromov.quantifiers: Every center and every positive ordered pair are included.
N-R-bishop-gromov.conclusion: Absolute upper comparison and relative growth control, without an absolute noncollapse claim.
N-R-bishop-gromov.status: Known theorem; general ratio-equality classification remains outside this block.
N-R-bishop-gromov.local_definitions: V_k^n and its spherical saturation are defined in the statement; no sine density is extended past its zero.

N-R-myers.objects: Connected complete smooth n-manifold without boundary, n>=2.
N-R-myers.domain: The entire manifold and its fundamental group.
N-R-myers.fixed_and_variable: One constant k>0 must work before quantifying all points and tangent vectors.
N-R-myers.hypotheses: Uniform positive Ricci lower bound with unnormalized factor n-1.
N-R-myers.quantifiers: The curvature inequality explicitly quantifies every x and v.
N-R-myers.conclusion: Compactness, diameter bound and finite fundamental group.
N-R-myers.status: Classical theorem; the current proof uses a strict negative-index contradiction and a complete universal cover.
N-R-myers.local_definitions: Ricci is defined in the curvature node; the block has no undefined model-volume or endpoint conventions.

N-R-hadamard.objects: Exponential map at every point of a connected complete smooth manifold with sec<=0.
N-R-hadamard.domain: The entire tangent vector space maps onto M; manifolds are without boundary under the shared scope.
N-R-hadamard.fixed_and_variable: Fix the metric; every p is permitted. Simple connectivity is a separate conditional hypothesis.
N-R-hadamard.hypotheses: Nonpositive sectional curvature and completeness, with simple connectivity only for the stronger conclusions.
N-R-hadamard.equations: exp_p:T_pM -> M is displayed; no local-domain restriction is left implicit.
N-R-hadamard.quantifiers: For every p, covering holds; under simple connectivity, every pair has a unique minimizing geodesic.
N-R-hadamard.conclusion: Covering first, global diffeomorphism and diffeomorphism with R^n in the simply connected case.
N-R-hadamard.status: Known theorem; no substitution of Ricci nonpositivity is asserted.
N-R-hadamard.local_definitions: The exponential map is introduced in the operational entry; covering and simple connectivity are distinguished in the mechanism.

N-R-toponogov.objects: Chosen minimizing triangle and its constant-curvature model surface; matching internal side points.
N-R-toponogov.domain: Distinct vertices, strict triangle inequalities and original perimeter below 2D_k.
N-R-toponogov.fixed_and_variable: Fix k and chosen actual sides; SSS fixes three lengths while SAS separately fixes two lengths and included angle.
N-R-toponogov.hypotheses: Connected complete smooth n-manifold without boundary and global sec>=k.
N-R-toponogov.equations: SSS angles >= model, SAS opposite distance <= model, SSS matching chord distance >= model.
N-R-toponogov.quantifiers: Every chosen angle and all matching u,v on the specified sides are included.
N-R-toponogov.conclusion: Three compatible inequalities for distinct fixed-data experiments, with no injectivity-radius condition on the global triangle.
N-R-toponogov.status: Classical strict-domain formulation; degenerate and spherical endpoint extensions are not promoted.
N-R-toponogov.local_definitions: D_k, model surface, model hinge and radial matching are specified inside the block.

findings: All seven exact canonical blocks retain their mathematical strength and domains. The isolated statement findings bind each block hash and identify all nine required aspects.

The connection/curvature entrance, actual radial variation, factor-t differential, cubic Taylor term and Gram determinant were recomputed. j is derived as a geometric density, with positive sign before conjugacy; it is not merely a renamed determinant.

The current-vector inverse A^{-1}, metric identification of Hessian, zero radial direction, Wronskian symmetry and Riccati sign agree. The regular matrix congruence uses an invertible fundamental matrix, not a falsely symmetric one; the singular order theorem remains explicitly imported.

The scalar trace proof uses no matrix-order theorem. Cauchy--Schwarz, u'+(a+c)u<=0, mu~Ct^2 and u=O(t) justify the zero-boundary comparison and density normalization. The -Q term precisely identifies the failure of the Ricci-upper reversal.

The cut-domain theorem is applied to the actual preimage t<min(r,tau); the null set is removed only after that identification. Downward zero extension, angular dominated convergence and local absolute continuity of the weighted quotient justify all finite positive radii below D_k. The independent Myers proof and terminal cut sphere handle k>0 at and beyond D_k.

The restricted index lemma follows from I(J,W)=0 and I(W,W)>=0 for endpoint-zero W. The model trial field yields [ff']; the distinct Myers fields yield (n-1)L((pi/L)^2-k)/2<0. Completeness of the universal cover and finiteness of a compact discrete fiber were checked.

Hadamard's convexity gives no angular kernel, and the radial differential closes the full local-invertibility claim. The pullback metric has entire radial geodesics for every initial velocity at zero; the one-point completeness criterion applies. Explicit radial inverse branches are disjoint and exhaustive. Simple connectivity is used only for one sheet.

Toponogov's local map is well typed using the n-dimensional model; the actual and model normal domains exclude conjugacy and s_k=0. The model chord stays in the map's domain, the model cosine law gives angle comparison, and a uniform nearby-center radius is supplied before passing to a moving-vertex limit.

Lang's exact 5.14 endpoint and balanced/minimizing assumptions were reread from the original text. Contraposition yields P_j<(4/5)^jP_0; the 9/5 consecutive-displacement estimate sums to a Cauchy tail 9P_0(4/5)^n. All auxiliary hinges needed for lower-curvature chord conversion have perimeter <= the original P. Technical gluing/conversion proofs remain imports.

Boundary computations were checked: S2xS2 mixed planes and Hessian/hinge failure, the flat cylinder's cut points without conjugacy, round-sphere Rauch cutoff, thin-cylinder volume collapse, incomplete Euclidean ball/hemisphere, and torus opposite distance 0.2 versus model 0.8. Günther is included only as the uncut lower-volume consequence required by the collapse boundary, not as an eighth promised principal.

Source image verification removes the false Lang 5/4 typo claim; the printed recurrence is 4/5. Bishop's printed missing factor 2 in Jacobi convexity is not copied: the local derivative has both factors 2.
